info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the modification of specific external agency agreements identified by a unique parameter. By using the PATCH method, clients can update various fields of the product broker agreement, enabling flexibility in managing agency relationships. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial organizations that need to respond quickly to changes in agency agreements. This ensures that the external partnerships remain current and compliant with evolving policies.

patch.description: Allows for updating the details of an existing product broker agreement with the specified identifier. This operation can modify various fields to keep the agreement current.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the existing product broker agreement with the identifier PROD-700045. It accepts a JSON object containing the specific fields that need to be modified. Ensure all required fields are included for successful updates.
